name: Choli Minaret
description: A Kurdistan Regional Government article published in August 2025 identifies Choli Minaret as a historic landmark in Erbil, reports its height as 37 metres, and describes planned restoration of its exterior and structure. The article provides evidence of the monument and its conservation context rather than a complete architectural history.
